description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeSalaryDecorator class within the OrangeHRM project. The class provides methods to set related entities such as Employee, PayPeriod, PayGrade, and CurrencyType on an EmployeeSalary object, using reference lookups. The code is part of the OrangeHRM human resource management system and follows common PHP class and namespace conventions.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for EmployeeSalary that provides methods to set associated entities such as Employee, PayPeriod, PayGrade, and CurrencyType by reference using entity IDs.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmployeeSalary object.

methods.name: getEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Protected method to retrieve the wrapped EmployeeSalary object.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity on the EmployeeSalary object based on the employee number.

methods.name: setPayPeriodById
methods.description: Sets the PayPeriod entity on the EmployeeSalary based on its ID.

methods.description: Sets the PayGrade entity on the EmployeeSalary based on its ID.

methods.description: Sets the CurrencyType entity on the EmployeeSalary based on its ID.
